verdict.rationale: Supabase offers indirect levers relevant to retention/deletion — self-hosting lets you fully control data lifecycle on your own infra, region selection addresses data residency, and automated backups touch on retention — but there is no explicit documentation of a user-facing data retention policy, backup retention configuration, or a documented project/account/data deletion workflow. Missing for 10: explicit data retention period controls, documented account/project/data deletion API or process, and GDPR-style right-to-erasure documentation.
